name: Elevra Consult
summary: Cool grey-blue consultancy site with two-tone grotesk headlines and a recurring deep-blue sky photography motif framed in white cards.

fonts.pairing: regular-weight geometric grotesk with very tight tracking for headlines, neutral display sans for body and labels

signature: two-line headlines where the second line drops to grey, used on every section title
deep-blue sky and hands photography repeated across hero, service and process cards
frosted glass quote cards laid over photos inside service rows
expanding accordion process: one wide photo step with three narrow numbered columns
imagery: grainy film-look photos of open blue skies, hands, wheat and balloons; one consistent cobalt grade
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 32px side padding, roughly 100px section padding, white 20px-radius cards on a pale grey page
